text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of the Japanese Derby, Duramente 
shocked everyone by announcing her entry 
into the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. She 
caused quite a stir, declaring her 
ambition to be the world's strongest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by that, Satono Crown, Kitasan 
Black, and their other generational rivals 
threw themselves enthusiastically into 
preparing for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Japanese Derby was held, and 
Duramente claimed an overwhelming victory 
with an astonishing run, fully 
demonstrating her prowess as the 
"strongest in the nation."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While cheers rained down on Duramente... 
her thoroughly defeated rivals shed tears, 
their shoulders trembling as their 
emotions burst forth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—If you don't give it your all, you don't 
even have the right to feel bitter. Even 
Cheval Grand, who didn't take up the 
challenge, felt a strange twinge of regret 
welling up inside.
